description_full: Western Copper and Gold Corporation, an exploration stage company, engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Canada. It explores for gold, copper, silver, and molybdenum deposits. Its principal property is the Casino mineral property located in Yukon, Canada. The company was formerly known as Western Copper Corp. and changed its name to Western Copper and Gold Corporation in October 2011. Western Copper and Gold Corporation was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

financial_summary: Western Copper and Gold Corpora is a small-cap basic materials business with a $337M market cap.
The company is burning through $2M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage of 40× is fortress-like.
Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 13% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
